campaign.purpose: Focused optimizer-only BCAP comparison: exactly 41 complete global recipes, fixed protocol seed 0, six required Tier 1 tasks plus the existing clock audit diagnostic, and no higher tiers. Complete independent current-tier jobs despite another peer failing. One worker per GPU, at most two GPU workers plus the existing automatic CPU worker; wall time is cost evidence only. Existing task data, architectures, initialization, priors, sampling, objectives, schedules, update budgets and evaluators remain fixed. Initial stage is a finite coarse rate screen, not the full requested Cartesian grid. No seed repetitions, gate repairs, default adoption, R1/R2/native/scale-transfer runs or automatic continuation. An edge optimum is reported as unresolved and may motivate a separately registered finite follow-up only for a supported-task improvement over the matched Adam control.

spec.hypothesis: Optimizer-only adam may match or improve the matched native-Adam BCAP control on sustained acquisition and quality under one global recipe across the unchanged Tier 1 tasks.
spec.rationale: Current public BCAP is Adam beta=(0,0.999), base LR 0.00425, D multiplier 1, prior multiplier 2, coefficient 1, prior_reg 0, constant schedule, live scoring; the pasted historical 0.0006/cosine recipe is not substituted. Protocol seed 0 and public deterministic initializer follow the repository comparison contract. All six required tasks and the existing diagnostic remain; failures being investigated separately receive no gate repair. Native-Adam control gets its own coarse sweep, including the exact incumbent base rate, with incumbent D/prior multipliers held fixed. Complete current-tier peers, then stop. The 41-recipe shared campaign reserves 103320 seconds (2520 per recipe); normalized step rates receive their own finite units and sweep. P1-P6 are screening observations only; five-seed statistical falsification, R1/R2, native100/five-modes/vector177 and scale transfer are deferred. No claim that seed noise, scaling transfer, local convergence or Adam magnitude versus direction is resolved from this tier.

speed_selection.reason: No frozen comparable first-acquisition timing contract is implemented for this search. Not all required adapters record per-observation seconds; original terminal-suffix or coverage-only times cannot supply full-quality first-acquisition speed.
